sources.entry: Discount Bandit ⚠ - Track pricing, stock status of products across multiple stores such as Amazon, Ebay, Walmart, etc. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Discount Bandit is a self-hosted PHP web app that tracks prices and stock status of products across multiple online stores and sends notifications when prices drop or meet set criteria.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Discount Bandit as a price tracker for favorite products across multiple stores. It has a built-in notification system that alerts the user when a price drops or matches specified criteria. It is accessed through a web interface. The awesome-selfhosted listing names Amazon, Ebay, and Walmart as examples of supported stores, and says it tracks stock status as well as price. The README gives no detail on scraping methods, scheduling, or notification channels beyond this. Documentation is linked externally.
use_cases: get alerted when a price drops
watch Amazon or eBay listings for deals
how_to_run: copy .env.example to .env and fill in the environment variables (see linked guide)
Alternatively, use a Docker image from the Docker repos mentioned in the README
notable: Built-in notification system for price drops or user-defined criteria
Tracks both price and stock status
SQLite works as the default database, so MySQL is optional
Docker images available from community repos linked in the README
Can be run with a MAMP-style local stack instead of installing each component
caveats: Setup requires installing PHP, Composer, a web server, and a database manually unless Docker is used
The README's install link is broken or malformed, so the environment setup steps are incomplete
Listed in awesome-selfhosted with a warning marker (⚠), whose meaning the listing does not explain
